comparatorRouteSelection.basis: Ordinary current Chemistry route. Preserve prior permitted RNA and Magnetic Resonance selections; complete 36 EC with first six other distinct BC1 entries in adopted formal list order, independently of UCR fit. No formal specialisation or annual availability guarantee. Bounded prerequisite repair: replace Catalysis3 by its own preparatory Metal Organic Chemistry3; retain 36 EC and other sound choices. Advanced Molecular Biology is completed before RNA, using the second/third-year choice framework.

alternativeSelection.assessment: follows the chemistry of living systems from biomolecules and enzymes through molecular cell biology, genetics, laboratory methods and disease mechanisms. The selected electives develop RNA, molecular biology and chemical biology. Environmental science and circular materials have weaker support in the selected sequence and do not justify a separate environmental chemistry programme. Radboud combines this strand with organic synthesis, physical and inorganic chemistry, quantum chemistry and specialist chemical laboratories.

curriculum.routeLabel: Ordinary full-time Chemistry bachelor; 36 EC Chemistry elective example
curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC comprises 126 EC of required courses, 36 EC of restricted scientific electives, a 12 EC individual research internship and 6 EC of free choice. All 36 EC in this example are selected Chemistry electives, rather than universally required courses; options may not run every year. Internship entry requires 120 EC including all first-year courses and prior proposal approval. First-year Academic Skills carries no extra credits; RADAr participation is required, but a passing score is not. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 39 EC. Course entry, attendance, overlap and approval rules apply.
